reason: A packet can remain in fusion for several local measurement updates; ask whether accumulated LOCAL consistency evidence has value beyond instantaneous monitoring and simple cache-value policies
novelty_warning: Whitening, GLS and sequential residual tests are existing tools; passing an engineering screen does not prove novelty
schedule: previous reference screen repeated irregular gaps; identical messages across policies
normal_training_policy: cap-only on common no-attack data; edge/age centered residual covariance, common for all monitors
normal_episode_control: calibrate maximum over all legal age prefixes in a no-attack cache residency; do not treat repeated correlated residuals as independent tests
monitor_update: hard-isolate a cache on first threshold exceedance; reset only when new packet arrives; fresh packet controller analogous at age0
parameter_selection: each detection policy uses normal validation only, lowest normal MSE among multiplier choices with normal cache-residency alarm rate <=0.06; fallback report if infeasible
age_decay_selection: normal validation MSE only, no attack-informed search; normal weight loss is information management, not automatically false alarm
main_comparison: GLS prefix-bias projection vs instant age-normalized cache spatial gate; joint covariance energy is a strong additional simple baseline
practical_gate: GLS receiver attack-excess MSE improves >=5% of receiver clean baseline relative to BOTH instantaneous and best normal age-only/fresh-only, in >=2 non-clean scenarios without normal network MSE degradation>2%; exploratory paired CI must favor candidate; otherwise stop or reduce to engineering correction
scope: Exploratory alternate question, not reuse of discarded tail calibration claim; conditional residual bias map M_age=H_i*A^age, no receiver-private information accessible to attacker
save: train/cal episodes, model stats, validation choices, full test states/weights/send/injection masks, episode diagnostics and source snapshots
